expected_threat_xt_engine.title: Expected Threat (xT) Grid & Progressive Ball Action Valuator
expected_threat_xt_engine.description: 16x12 Markov value iteration Expected Threat (xT) pitch model to quantify on-ball progression value (Delta xT) of passes and carries, identifying high-threat creators.

notes.note: Activated as main branch
Commence implementation and verification of 16x12 Expected Threat (xT) engine
10/10 tests passing; 202,690 evaluations/sec pure-memory algorithm throughput; Karun Singh (2019) 16x12 Bellman value iteration confirmed.

external_research.findings: Karun Singh (2018/2019) formulated Expected Threat (xT) as recursive Bellman payoff equation xT_z = (s_z * g_z) + (m_z * sum(T_{z->z'} * xT_{z'})), dividing pitch into 16x12 grid (192 zones). Solved via value iteration until convergence, computing Delta xT = xT(z_end) - xT(z_start) for passes and carries.
external_research.reason: Fills the fundamental gap between xG (shots only, ~25/match) and pass completion (quantity without progression value), providing true playmaker threat quantification.

metabolic_power_fatigue_engine.title: Metabolic Power & High-Intensity Workload Kinematics Engine
metabolic_power_fatigue_engine.description: Osgnach (2010) and di Prampero equivalent slope acceleration energy model calculating instantaneous Metabolic Power (W/kg), High Metabolic Load Distance (HMLD >25.5 W/kg), and Equivalent Distance to monitor player fatigue without GPS wearables.

notes.note: Activated as secondary branch
Commence implementation and verification of Osgnach 2010 Metabolic Power and HMLD engine
10/10 tests passing; 10,661,454 points/sec pure-memory algorithm throughput; Osgnach 2010 / di Prampero HMLD and Equivalent Distance confirmed.

external_research.findings: Osgnach et al. (2010) and di Prampero (2005) modeled accelerating running on flat ground as equivalent to constant-speed running on an incline ES = a/g. Energy cost EC = (155.4*ES^5 - 30.4*ES^4 - 32.8*ES^3 + 43.3*ES^2 + 39.7*ES + 3.6)*EM*KT, yielding instantaneous metabolic power MP = EC * v (W/kg). Integrates High Metabolic Load Distance (HMLD, distance at MP > 25.5 W/kg) and Equivalent Distance (ED = Total Energy / 3.6).
external_research.reason: Elevates athletic analysis from naive speed/distance metrics to professional physiological sports science standard, tracking explosive acceleration/deceleration costs that cause muscle fatigue.
